list.title: Goals

detail.unlink_failed: Couldn't unlink the task. Try again.
detail.not_found: This goal doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.
detail.workspace_goal_visible: This goal has no project, so everyone in the workspace can see it.
detail.project_moved_scope: This goal now has no project, so everyone in the workspace can see it.

form.title: Title
form.title_placeholder: What outcome should this goal deliver?
form.create_failed: Couldn't create the goal. Your input is still here; try again.
form.save_failed: Couldn't save the goal. Your changes are still here; try again.
form.project_locked: Unlink every task before moving this goal to another project.
form.owner_cleared: Owner unavailable. Pick another owner or leave it empty.

confirm.reopen_description: The goal returns to planned. Its linked tasks aren't affected.
confirm.delete_description: The goal and its task links are deleted. The tasks themselves are kept.
confirm.delete_failed: Couldn't delete the goal. Try again.

link.description: Only tasks in the same project can be linked.
link.conflict_already_linked: That task is already linked to another goal.
link.conflict_project_mismatch: That task belongs to a different project than this goal.

plan.title: Plan
plan.save_failed: Couldn't save the plan. Your edits are still here; try again.
plan.unsaved_hint: Unsaved edits aren't part of a planning run.
plan.refresh_failed: Couldn't refresh the plan. Showing the last loaded version.
plan.project_required: Link this goal to a project to draft and generate a plan.
plan.intent_placeholder: Describe the outcome in one sentence
plan.no_agents: No available agent can plan this goal.
plan.run_pending: The planning agent is working. This panel updates by itself.
plan.run_without_plan: The planning run finished without submitting a plan.
plan.unknown_state_hint: This client doesn't recognize the run state. Check again or start a new run.
plan.request_conflict: This request was already used for a different run. Start a new run.
plan.no_permission: You can't use this planning agent.
plan.start_failed: Couldn't start the planning run. Try again.
plan.candidate_incomplete: This candidate is incomplete and can't be applied.
plan.candidate_applied_hint: This candidate is already part of the saved plan.
plan.stale_description: This run started from revision {{base}}; the plan is now revision {{current}}. Applying merges it into your draft.
plan.apply_description: Your edits and existing task bindings are kept. The merged draft is saved as a new revision.
plan.project_conflict_title: This planning run belongs to another project
plan.project_conflict_description: Its candidate and basis were hidden. Reload the current plan before starting another run.
plan.section_project_conflict: This plan or planning run belongs to another project. Unsaved edits from that project are kept here but can't be saved to this one; reloading the current plan discards them.
plan.conflict_description: Your edits are kept. Reload revision {{revision}} to compare, or save yours over it.
plan.empty: No tasks yet. Add one, or generate a plan.
plan.binding_picker_description: Only tasks in this goal's project can be bound.
plan.dependency_required: Choose a task and write the reason.
plan.start_revision_conflict: The plan changed before the run started. Reload the plan and start again.
plan.start_unavailable: This goal or its planning agent is no longer available to you.
plan.generation_unavailable: This planning run can't be read here. Reload the plan and try again.
plan.generation_not_ready: This plan isn't ready to apply yet. Wait for the run to finish, then try again.
plan.generation_already_applied: This plan was already applied, so this attempt saved nothing. Reload the plan to see the current version.
plan.generation_retryable: The planning run couldn't be confirmed yet. Retry this request; your text is kept.
plan.start_refused: This request was refused before a run started. Nothing was created; start a new run when you're ready.
plan.plan_unavailable: This plan can't be read here. Reload it to continue.

closure.title: Acceptance
closure.description: The server decides whether this goal can be accepted. Linked task statuses and run exits don't.
closure.hint_can_close: Accepting records this delivery as accepted.
closure.hint_wait_review: This delivery has no valid independent pass recorded yet.
closure.hint_wait_human: Technical evidence may be complete, but a person still owns this decision.
closure.hint_needs_changes: The work must change before this goal can be accepted.
closure.hint_blocked: A required condition is missing or can't be read.
closure.hint_unknown: This app version doesn't recognize the server's decision, so it isn't treated as ready.
closure.reason_cancelled: The goal is cancelled. Cancellation isn't acceptance.
closure.reason_not_managed: No closure contract covers this goal; accepting it is a human decision.
closure.reason_no_delivery: No fixed delivery version is registered to accept.
closure.reason_human_step: A human review step is still open.
closure.reason_authorization: No one is authorized to accept this goal automatically.
closure.reason_authorization_revoked: The acceptance authorization was revoked or is no longer active.
closure.reason_authorization_scope: The authorization doesn't cover this goal or this action.
closure.reason_authorization_stale: The authorization was granted for an earlier acceptance scope.
closure.reason_no_independent_review: No valid review covers this delivery and scope.
closure.reason_review_failed: An independent review failed this delivery.
closure.reason_missing_deliverable: A required delivery condition isn't satisfied.
closure.reason_unknown_evidence: The required delivery conditions can't be read, so they aren't treated as complete.
closure.reason_not_closer: The caller isn't the authorized closer.
closure.reason_unknown: The server gave a reason this app version doesn't recognize.
closure.next_actor_fallback: A person named by the server
closure.authorization_none: No one is scoped to accept this goal. A person can still accept it.
closure.reviews_note: Recorded verdicts. The server decides which one counts for the current delivery and scope.
closure.reviews_empty: No review is recorded for this goal.
closure.accept_description: Accepting marks this goal completed. It's your decision as a person; linked task statuses and run exits don't make it.
closure.accept_warning: Accepting now goes against the server's decision. The goal is completed, but its acceptance evidence stays incomplete.
closure.accept_failed: Couldn't accept the goal. Try again.
closure.reject_description: The goal stays open. Your reason is recorded as a review requiring changes, so agents can't accept it until new evidence passes.
closure.reject_scope_placeholder: Which tasks or areas must be redone (optional)
closure.reject_failed: Couldn't record the rejection. Try again.
closure.reject_needs_delivery: A rejection is recorded against a fixed delivery version. None is registered yet, so nothing was recorded and the goal stays open.
closure.reject_stale: The delivery or scope changed. Reload the acceptance state and reject again.
closure.cancelled_hint: This goal is cancelled. Cancellation isn't acceptance.
closure.unavailable: The acceptance state isn't available to this account.
closure.degraded: The server's acceptance reply couldn't be read. Nothing is treated as accepted.
closure.grant_description: A grant lets an agent accept this goal only after an independent review passes the current delivery. It doesn't authorize a merge, a release or a deployment.
closure.grant_covers_children: Also allow closing the goal's linked tasks
closure.grant_failed: Couldn't record the authorization. Try again.
closure.stale: Couldn't refresh the acceptance state; this is the last result the server returned.

execution.title: Execution
execution.description: Create one task per planned item. Running this again reuses the same task instead of creating a duplicate.
execution.create_failed: Couldn't create the tasks. Nothing is shown as created; try again.
execution.unconfirmed: The server didn't confirm these bindings. Reload the plan before trying again.
execution.unconfirmed_hint: Nothing was shown as created because the reply was incomplete.
execution.save_first: Save the plan before creating tasks. Execution always uses the saved plan.
execution.none: The plan has no tasks yet.
execution.dep_ready: Prerequisites are accepted; the task can start.
execution.dep_not_done: Waiting for a prerequisite to finish.
execution.dep_not_accepted: The prerequisite is done but has no currently valid acceptance.
execution.dep_unknown: A prerequisite isn't linked to a task yet, so the dependency can't be evaluated.
execution.dep_unreadable: The prerequisite state can't be read.
execution.dep_recovery: Finishing and accepting the prerequisite releases this through a real dependency event; refreshing only rereads the state.
execution.run_started: A run was started for this task.
execution.run_no_assignee: No run: the task has no assignee.
execution.run_waiting_dependency: No run yet: it starts once its prerequisites are accepted.
execution.run_not_enqueued: No run was enqueued for this task.
execution.assignee_note: An assignee starts the task's run when the task is created. It doesn't overwrite an existing task's assignee.
execution.deferred_note: A task parked for a dependency is deferred with no scheduled time; it resumes only after a prerequisite event.
